purpose: Freeze exact F2 and F3A.5 documentary sources before Phase-3A synthesis and closure.

f2_provenance.provenance_method: Git history plus repository-relative path and SHA-256, with a later immutable tag that contains byte-exact copies.

sources.authoritative_for: F2 cohort size, admissibility, baseline verification, global transition counts, optimizer stability, conditional period robustness, interpretation boundaries.
sources.not_authoritative_for: Catalogue-scale F3A denominators, physical QPP truth, observational sensitivity/specificity/FPR.

sources.authoritative_for: Permitted qualitative interpretation of F2 robustness, repeated-measures scope, stable-classification versus numerical-uniqueness distinction.
sources.not_authoritative_for: New statistics, physical validation, correction/selection-function claims.

sources.authoritative_for: F2 factual claim-to-source mapping and explicit allowed/prohibited interpretations.
sources.not_authoritative_for: F3A catalogue-scale results not yet available in Phase 2.

sources.authoritative_for: Historical status of F2 robustness, validation, ground-truth, optimizer and correction claims.
sources.not_authoritative_for: Any upgrade of a previously prohibited claim without new frozen evidence.

sources.authoritative_for: Historical F2 limitations and remaining requirements.
sources.not_authoritative_for: Resolution of limitations not explicitly addressed by later frozen evidence.

sources.authoritative_for: F2 closure status, manuscript viability, correction/held-out requirement, prohibited Phase-2 conclusions.
sources.not_authoritative_for: Formal Phase-3A closure before F3A evidence exists.

sources.authoritative_for: Integrated F2 methodological interpretation and Route-A/Route-B separation.
sources.not_authoritative_for: Pooling F2 with F3A or claiming later catalogue-scale validation.

sources.authoritative_for: 122-event baseline gate and role-specific concordant/mismatch/inadmissible counts.
sources.not_authoritative_for: Physical truth or cause of baseline mismatch.

sources.authoritative_for: Primary planned/elegible/inadmissible rows and baseline-conditioned transition counts.
sources.not_authoritative_for: Independent-event inference, physical accuracy, sensitivity, specificity or FPR.
True physical period or period robustness for lost/inadmissible classifications.

sources.authoritative_for: Validated catalogue-scale counts, numerical diagnostics and scientific-boundary flags.
sources.not_authoritative_for: Ground truth, formal inferential claims or candidate discovery.
Any new metric or threshold absent from frozen F3A.5.
